messages:
Maya: Quick UX sync 1 — noticed inconsistent behavior for in-console help links. Some open our sidecar docs panel, others go to the docs site (new tab). Feels jarring and hurts keyboard users.
Maya: Specifics: routes list tooltip -> external tab; model detail — Learn more -> sidecar; dashboard chart — "See docs" -> external. Also labels differ: console uses "Model Config" in one place and docs mostly use "Model Variant".
Zane: Thanks. Which flows are highest priority to fix?
Maya: Priority order: 1) model detail -> must be sidecar (frequent path) 2) routes list tooltips -> switch to sidecar or inline help 3) dashboard -> sidecar unless it's a long reference doc (legal/security).
Jules: Implementation approach: wire a single helper util openDocs({anchor, preferSidecar:true, analyticsContext}) that picks sidecar vs external and emits `event: docs_open` with {source, anchor, sidecar}. Then change links to call that util. For anchors we can canonicalize to `docs:<section>:<anchor>` so aliases map server-side.
Elaine: a11y items: when sidecar opens we must 1) focus the sidecar container, 2) announce via aria-live region like "Docs panel opened: Serving > Scaling" and 3) trap focus inside until user closes. If we still open new tab for external pages, link should include `rel="noopener noreferrer"` and text must indicate it opens a new tab (or use aria-label).
Maya: Good. Also: breadcrumb mismatch — docs breadcrumbs say "Docs / Serving" while console shows "Docs > Inference". Product taxonomy needs to be consistent.
Zane: Product decision: canonical nav should be "Docs 7 Inference 7 Serving" (use U+203A as separator). Update docs nav JSON and the console breadcrumb component to render nav keys.
Jules: For the sidecar route: propose `/console/docs?anchor=serving.scaling&mode=sidecar&source=dashboard`. We can use router.push with `replaceState` toggled so opening help from repeated clicks doesn't bloat history. Also include `?from_ts=` for analytics sampling.
Maya: On copy: standardize to "Model Variant" across console and docs. We'll deprecate "Model Config" and add a short support line "Model variant = family + weights + tuning" under the selector.
Elaine: Tests: add keyboard E2E that tabs to a help link, activates it, asserts sidecar is focused and aria-live message is read; add unit test for analytics payload. Also add a screenreader run in CI for the primary flow.
Jules: I'll pick up the copy keys and the openDocs util. Plan: small PR that changes link handlers + one example page (model detail) and adds analytics hook.
Maya: I'll update docs anchors and add alias redirects so old external anchors still work. Docs team owns server-side alias map.
Zane: Ops note: check caching for docs sidecar HTML endpoints so we don't introduce latency. Also inform infra if new analytics events go to a new topic.
ops-bot: Heads up: staging deploy window 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC. Avoid large router changes after 2026-03-31 23:30 UTC.
Maya: Rough timeline? Jules: copy + util PR this week, docs anchor redirects this week, Elaine e2e next sprint.
Jules: Action items: (1) Jules: PR for openDocs util + switch one page (model detail) (2) Maya: anchor alias map + docs redirects (3) Elaine: a11y e2e + aria-live pattern (4) Zane: update product nav JSON and confirm analytics topic. Acceptance criteria: unified term "Model Variant" across UI and docs, all in-app help links open sidecar by default, keyboard flow traps and announces focus, analytics emits `docs_open` with sidecar flag.
Maya: tagging `#eng`, `#docs` and `#accessibility`. Will post PR links here. Thanks! :raised_hands:
